feedback: You created a function named handleInputChange that takes an event parameter, which is good. However, the function only uses event.target.value and doesn't use event.target.name to update the specific form field. The step requires using both event.target.name and event.target.value to update the form state correctly.
hint: Use event.target.name as the key and event.target.value as the value in your setForm call.
errors: handleInputChange doesn't use event.target.name to identify which field to update
The setForm call should update the specific field based on the input's name attribute
